SUMMARY & PURPOSE

Secret key manager with generate modal, masked token display, and revocation buttons.

WHEN IT WORKS (IDEAL FOR)
•
Developer portals managing authentication tokens
WHEN IT IS INAPPROPRIATE (AVOID FOR)
•
Consumer frontends without API keys
JOBS TO BE DONE
Generate, view, and revoke programmatic developer API keys
EXPECTED CONTENT REQUIREMENTS
High data density, keyboard accessibility, semantic tokens
TARGET PRODUCT ARCHETYPES
b2b-saas (95%)
developer-tool (90%)
data-product (85%)
